definitions.explanation: A mountain or hill with an opening through which lava, ash, and gases are or have been erupted.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}には{多|おお}くの{火山|かざん}がある。
{火山|かざん}が{噴火|ふんか}した。
{活火山|かつかざん}には{近|ちか}づかないほうがいい。
examples.english: It's better not to approach an active volcano.

notes:
USAGE: Japan is one of the most volcanically active countries, with over 100 active volcanoes.

TYPES:
・{活火山|かつかざん} (active volcano)
・{休火山|きゅうかざん} (dormant volcano)
・{死火山|しかざん} (extinct volcano)

RELATED TERMS:
・{噴火|ふんか} (eruption)
・{溶岩|ようがん} (lava)
・{火口|かこう} (crater)
・{火山灰|かざんばい} (volcanic ash)
・{温泉|おんせん} (hot spring - often found near volcanoes)

FAMOUS JAPANESE VOLCANOES: {富士山|ふじさん}, {桜島|さくらじま}, {阿蘇山|あそさん}
